Muhammad Yunus was the brother-in-law of Mohammad Ali Dhamtari wale. slides.text: End of Movement There is a town Chauri Chaura , near Gorakhpur in Uttar Pradesh where during the non-cooperation movement, on 5 February 1922, the demonstrators set a police post on fire, killing 22 police personnel hiding in it. As a result of this, Gandhi said that the non-cooperation movement was no longer suitable due to violence and had withdrawn it. Due to this action, Gandhi withdrew the movement on 12 February 1922 with the Bardoli resolution.
